name: Revcode
shortDescription: Build sales research and outreach workflows with AI, structured tables, and your team.
description:
A Revcode account is required. Using Claude Code or OpenAI Codex requires a separate CLI installation and an authenticated provider account with an eligible plan. Other integrations may require their own credentials. Revcode subscriptions and optional usage credits are sold separately; third-party services may charge additional fees.

Revcode is a desktop workspace for sales teams and outbound agencies. Bring lead research, structured tables, reusable workflows, and client context together in one place.

Work with Claude Code or Codex alongside your data to research companies, prepare lead lists, and build repeatable enrichment workflows. Keep the results in tables, connect the services your team uses, and save project context for future work.

Use Revcode to:
- Organize company and lead research in structured tables.
- Build and run workflows with your connected AI agent.
- Import and export CSV files.
- Save project memory and reusable context.
- Connect enrichment and research providers.
- Collaborate in shared team workspaces.
- Publish supported workflows for hosted execution.

Revcode includes live generative AI integrations. Generated content may be inaccurate; review results before using them. You can report problems or inappropriate content through the app feedback feature or by contacting support.

Internet access is required for sign-in, AI providers, and cloud features. See revcode.ai for current plans and availability.
